<!-- All news items below this line -->{{Current events|year=2003|month=11|day=23|content=
* A [[BBC]] ''Correspondent'' programme, based on [[computer-generated image]]s, suggests that the [[Warren Commission]]'s controversial [[Single bullet theory|magic bullet theory]], in which it was claimed that the same bullet hit President [[John F. Kennedy]] and Governor [[John Connally]] during Kennedy's assassination in 1963, was correct. Using state of the art computer generated images based on the [[Zapruder film]], the programme concludes that a lone gunman could have shot Kennedy. [[ABC News (United States)|ABC News]] and [[Court TV]] arrived at a similar conclusion<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.courttv.com/onair/shows/kennedy/index.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071207201042/http://www.courttv.com/onair/shows/kennedy/index.html |archive-date=2007-12-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[Rose Revolution]]: beleaguered [[Georgia (country)|Georgian]] President [[Eduard Shevardnadze]] resigns. Elections will be in 45 days, but until then, [[Nino Burdzhanadze]] will be the acting president.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://story.news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story&cid=514&e=2&u=/ap/20031123/ap_on_re_eu/georgia_protests|title=Yahoo News - Latest News & Headlines|work=Yahoo News|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/3231534.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Europe - People power forces Georgia leader out|date=24 November 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* Nationalist party [[HDZ]] appears set to beat the ruling centre-left coalition in [[2003 Croatian parliamentary election|Croatia's general election]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/3230260.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Europe - Croat nationalists poised for win|date=24 November 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>http://uk.news.yahoo.com/031123/325/eeqic.html</ref>
* [[EADS]], the largest European aircraft company, is doing preliminary work on a [[hypersonic]] passenger aircraft that would take the place of the recently retired [[Concorde]]; the planning includes collaboration with Japanese firms and [[Ministry of International Trade and Industry]].<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/business/3231354.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Business - Firm considers 'son of Concorde'|date=23 November 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref> However, its subsidiary [[Airbus]]' [[Airbus A380|A380]] 'super-jumbo' sub-sonic vehicle is the product expected to become the dominant commercial aircraft in the near-future.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=businessNews&storyID=3877882|title=Business|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-date=8 December 2004|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041208194358/http://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml?type=businessNews&storyID=3877882|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* The ''[[New York Times]]'' reports that the [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] is actively monitoring and gathering intelligence on anti-war protest movements' activities, ostensibly to detect possible [[terrorism|terrorist]] activity. Opponents such as the [[American Civil Liberties Union]] criticize the practice as regressionary to the days of [[J. Edgar Hoover]]'s intense monitoring of private organizations for potential [[communist]] links.<ref>{{Cite news | url=https://www.nytimes.com/2003/11/23/national/23FBI.html?ei=5062&en=67560367b7120964&ex=1070168400&partner=GOOGLE&pagewanted=all&position= |title = F.b.i. Scrutinizes Antiwar Rallies|newspaper = The New York Times|date = 23 November 2003|last1 = Lichtblau|first1 = Eric}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.cnn.com/2003/US/11/23/security.fbi.reut/index.html|title=CNN.com - FBI keeps eye on antiwar protesters - Nov. 24, 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* The People's Republic of China plans to start tests of a [[SARS]] vaccine on humans by the end of December; trials with monkeys show that the vaccine was effective.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/asia-pacific/3230418.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Asia-Pacific - China planning Sars vaccine tests|date=23 November 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
* 10,000 trade unionists, environmentalists, and farm workers march in [[Miami]] to protest against the [[Free Trade Area of the Americas]] expansion meeting. Other street protests erupt into violent confrontations with police several times throughout the day. Protester sources indicate upwards of 250 protesters incarcerated, along with reports of physical and sexual assault while in custody.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.infoshop.org/inews/stories.php?story=03/11/15/8771331|title=Infoshop News|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051123195739/http://www.infoshop.org/inews/stories.php?story=03%2F11%2F15%2F8771331|archive-date=23 November 2005|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.democracynow.org/article.pl?sid=03/11/22/0011213|title=Democracy Now!|accessdate=22 December 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20071115014548/http://www.democracynow.org/article.pl?sid=03%2F11%2F22%2F0011213|archive-date=15 November 2007|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.commondreams.org/headlines03/1122-03.htm |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121005104231/http://www.commondreams.org/headlines03/1122-03.htm |archive-date=2012-10-05 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ictsd.org/weekly/03-11-19/story3.htm |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070927004203/http://www.ictsd.org/weekly/03-11-19/story3.htm |archive-date=2007-09-27 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.miami.com/mld/miamiherald/business/7266885.htm |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041207034846/http://www.miami.com/mld/miamiherald/business/7266885.htm |archive-date=2004-12-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref> Other demonstrations take place in cities throughout the Americas.
* [[American occupation of Iraq|Occupation of Iraq]]:
** Three US troops are killed in Iraq, two of them in a civilian vehicle in [[Mosul]] and the third in a roadside bombing in [[Baquba]]. A mob desecrates the bodies of the Mosul victims and loots their gear.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://news.yahoo.com/news?tmpl=story2&cid=540&u=/ap/20031123/ap_on_re_mi_ea/iraq_630&printer=1|title=Yahoo News - Latest News & Headlines|work=Yahoo News|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/middle_east/3230690.stm|title=BBC NEWS - Middle East - Three US troops killed in Iraq|date=23 November 2003|publisher=|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref>
** A female acting [[Ambassador (diplomacy)|ambassador]] to the US is chosen by Iraq's [[Governing Council]]: [[Rend al-Rahim Francke]], an Iraqi/American educated in Britain, France and Lebanon.<ref>https://www.reuters.com/newsArticle.jhtml;jsessionid=4PU2ESEZODN0ECRBAE0CFFA?type=topNews&storyID=3877806{{Dead link|date=August 2021 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>
* A US military helicopter crashes near [[Bagram]], [[Afghanistan]], killing five soldiers and wounding seven.<ref>http://uk.news.yahoo.com/031123/325/eeqjm.html</ref>
* Indian newspapers reported on the results of an in-depth [https://web.archive.org/web/20060822115522/http://www.ciet.org/www/image/download/Pak2002baseline.pdf 2002 survey] of 57,321 Pakistanis in 89 [[Districts of Pakistan|districts]] of [[Pakistan]]. Although the survey was primarily concerned with the performance of local governments, the newspapers mischaracterized its results as the "utter dissatisfaction" of Pakistanis with the government of [[President of Pakistan|Pakistani president]] [[Pervez Musharraf]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.expressindia.com/fullstory.php?newsid=26297 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050507230641/http://www.expressindia.com/fullstory.php?newsid=26297 |archive-date=2005-05-07 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/articleshow/297394.cms|title=Tough days ahead for Musharraf?|work=The Times of India|accessdate=22 December 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://origin.ndtv.com/template/template.asp?template=&id=45317&callid=1 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-18 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141011144038/http://origin.ndtv.com/template/template.asp?template=&id=45317&callid=1 |archive-date=2014-10-11 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
